overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Plan Commission was scheduled to hold a public hearing and take action on three significant development proposals: a conditional use permit for a nonmetallic mine operation, a zoning change request, and a certified survey map for land division. The meeting was also set to include a community development director report and zoning code review discussion.

agenda.item: Announcement of Public Hearing - Conditional Use Permit (Eau Claire River LLC) for nonmetallic mine at 1320 Kowalski Rd
Announcement of Public Hearing - Zoning Change Request (Jean Pochinski) at 3115 Aspen Rd from RR5 to RR2
Certified Survey Map (Jean Pochinski) - land division to create two lots
Zoning Change Request (Jean Pochinski) - RR5 to RR2 zoning change
Conditional Use Permit (Eau Claire River LLC) - nonmetallic mine permit

discussions.item: Conditional Use Permit (Eau Claire River LLC)
discussions.body: Eau Claire River, LLC was scheduled to present a request for a Conditional Use Permit to operate a nonmetallic mine on a 35.58-acre parcel at 1320 Kowalski Rd in Kronenwetter. The commission was set to hold a public hearing on this proposal and expected to consider action on the permit application.

Jean Pochinski was scheduled to request a zoning change of 2.89 acres at 3115 Aspen Rd from RR5 (Rural Residential 5) to RR2 (Rural Residential 2) zoning classification. The commission was set to hold a public hearing and expected to consider this zoning reclassification request.

Jean Pochinski was scheduled to request approval of a Certified Survey Map to divide an 11-acre parcel into two lots at 3115 Aspen Rd. The commission was expected to review and possibly act on this land division application.
The Plan Commission was scheduled to receive a report from the Community Development Director regarding ongoing village development matters and planning initiatives.
The commission was set to discuss and review the village's zoning code as part of its ongoing regulatory oversight responsibilities.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, with a 15-minute total time limit and three-minute per-person limit, subject to extension by the presiding officer.
actionItems: Expected to vote on Conditional Use Permit for nonmetallic mine (Eau Claire River LLC)
Expected to vote on Zoning Change Request from RR5 to RR2 (Jean Pochinski)
Expected to vote on Certified Survey Map for land division (Jean Pochinski)
Scheduled to review and discuss Zoning Code
title: Plan Commission Meeting - 2026-10-19
